headline: Last session: Sensex tumbles 460 points as IT drags indices and crude tops $97

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 1 December.

why: Brent crude topping $97 weighed on market sentiment during the last session.
Drag in IT sector stocks exerted downward pressure on benchmark indices.
Profit-taking after a three-day mid-week rally.
Influence from weak global market cues.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex tumbled over 460 points in early trade, snapping a three-day rally.
Nifty 50 traded below the 25,900 level during early trading on Friday.
Metal stocks outperformed the broader market while IT stocks dragged indices lower.
Gold has beaten Nifty over a 5-year horizon despite a 30% drop.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty snapped their mid-week recovery to trade lower, with Sensex tumbling over 460 points. The decline was primarily driven by weakness in IT stocks and rising crude prices topping $97, even as metal stocks outperformed. The market is closed today due to the weekend.
